$comment: Module tree. Order here = canonical order (deck order, UI order, generation order). 'size' = target number of member concepts (including concepts whose primary module is elsewhere, e.g. Core). 'core' modules are mutually exclusive frequency bands. 'adult' modules are shown with an 18+ badge. Module IDs are permanent (they appear in file names and Anki tags).

modules.desc: The ~500 most frequent words shared by all languages.
